sets.name: Miscellaneous Promos
ident: One card: Ancient Mew, given out with Pokémon: The Movie 2000.

sets.name: Jumbo Cards
ident: Oversized (jumbo) cards.

sets.name: Unseen Forces Unown Collection
ident: The number is a letter or sign instead of a number: A/28 to Z/28, then !/28 and ?/28.

sets.name: Radiant Collection
ident: No set symbol of its own: the number starts with RC (RC1/RC25 to RC25/RC25).

sets.name: Yellow A Alternate
ident: Same yellow A symbol as Hidden Fates Shiny Vault, but here it's on the RIGHT of the card.
Numbers end in a (24a, 28a, 54a...).

sets.name: Hidden Fates Shiny Vault
ident: Yellow A symbol on the LEFT of the card. Yellow A Alternate cards have the same symbol on the right.
Numbers start with SV (SV1–SV94).

sets.name: Trick or Trade 2022
ident: Pikachu pumpkin stamp only. Yellow border: the only Trick or Trade year with yellow borders.
Every card has a Sword & Shield set symbol.
Came in orange BOOster bundles with Gengar art.

sets.name: Trick or Trade 2023
ident: Pikachu pumpkin stamp only. Silver border.
Set symbol is a Sword & Shield one, or the set code is SVI or PAL.
The 10 holos are mirror/line holo, not Cosmos.
Came in green BOOster bundles.

sets.name: My First Battle
ident: No set symbol is printed on these cards.

sets.name: Trick or Trade 2024
ident: Pikachu pumpkin stamp only (no Play! Pokémon logo). Silver border.
Set codes are later Scarlet & Violet ones: OBF, MEW, PAR, PAF, TEF or TWM.
The 10 holos are Cosmos holo (swirling bubbles over the art and the border).
Came in orange BOOster bundles with Umbreon art.

sets.name: Pokéween 2025
ident: Pikachu pumpkin stamp plus the Play! Pokémon logo.
Only 1 card: Spiritomb 087/132 (Mega Evolution), silver border, reverse holo.
Given out at Play! Pokémon League events, October 2025.

sets.name: Pokéween 2026
ident: Pikachu pumpkin stamp plus the Play! Pokémon logo.
Only 3 cards: Zubat 049/086, Golbat 050/086 and Crobat 051/086 (Chaos Rising), silver border, reverse holo.
Given out at Play! Pokémon League events, October 2026.
